label: Iterating the coupling
subgoals: Compute the power at the current temperature
Update the temperature from the power

label: The converged temperature
subgoals: Compute the loop gain of the coupling
Divide the uncoupled rise by one minus the gain
Add the rise to the ambient temperature

label: Thermal runaway
subgoals: Set the loop gain equal to one
Check that the operating point keeps margin to runaway
